latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — enables teams to select a defensible North Star Metric based on core value delivery, not vanity metrics.

- Guides users through confirming the product’s aha moment and value proposition.
- Constructs a tailored growth equation for the product’s business model.
- Enumerates and scores North Star Metric candidates, rejecting vanity and proxy metrics.
- Recommends a primary North Star Metric and 2-3 supporting input metrics.
- Produces clear markdown deliverables: north-star-recommendation.md and growth-equation.md.
